title: Review evidence and prepare for assessment

blocks.title: Recall the common unit
blocks.instructions: Use a short example to recall equal-sized wholes and equivalent fractional parts.

blocks.title: Explain a complete solution
blocks.instructions: Model an inspectable calculation, a reasonable total and a word-problem unit without rehearsing assessment items.

blocks.title: Review through practice
blocks.instructions: Students work on fresh examples while the teacher uses reviewed September 30 work to select brief support or extension.

blocks.title: Apply and discuss
blocks.instructions: Solve new fraction-addition contexts. Ask students to explain their method and record the help they receive.

blocks.title: Name the next check
blocks.instructions: Students show a short calculation or question for a teacher conference. Keep the October 2 assessment date fixed.
